notes.title: Warhammer 40k Boltgun 2 will surprise you until the very end, says lead dev
notes.content:
On Wednesday, Wargamer had the great pleasure to welcome Aaron Ashbrooke, creative director at Auroch Digital and the visionary behind the excellent retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, to our Discord for an hour-long live AMA with our community. It was a blast - and in the course of fielding questions covering everything from Auroch Digital's companywide obsession with Warhammer 40,000, to the delightfully bizarre Warhammer 40k typing game Words of Vengeance, Ashbrooke let us know some juicy tidbits about how the team is approaching Boltgun 2.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: A 'gruesome' free Warhammer 40,000 typing game on Steam heralds the announcement of Boltgun 2, coming in 2026
notes.content: I liked Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun quite a bit. I'm not a huge Warhammer guy, but a straight-up boomer shooter I can quickly jump in and out of for a few minutes of blood and guts when the urge strikes? That's my jam. So I think it's very good news that more is on the way: During today's Warhammer Skulls Showcase, Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 was officially announced and set for launch in 2026... Read more.

notes.title: Welcome back, Space Marines!
notes.content:
[h2]Are You Ready to Purge, AGAIN?  [/h2]

The Emperor looked kindly upon us and blessed us with a long-awaited sequel for retro boomer shooter [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005010/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun/]Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun[/url]!   

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 was just announced at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/skulls2025]Warhammer Skulls Showcase[/url] and you can check out the reveal trailer below 👇

[previewyoutube=rG19wrCGR5g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]An All-New Adventure! [/h2]

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40:000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005010/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun/

[h2]Brothers! War Calls You. Will You Answer? [/h2]

Don’t miss the other title we announced at the Warhammer Skulls Showcase:  

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3533730/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun__Words_of_Vengeance/]Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance[/url] is a hilarious twist on Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, where you condemn heretics to death with every keystroke!
